user.title: Add a vehicle
user.description: Pick the devices below and EV Ledger finds every sensor it needs: (1) your car (Tesla Custom, Tesla Fleet, Teslemetry or Tessie; leave empty for another car and pick its sensors on the next page), (2) your home charger, (3) a charging app/account such as Monta, (4) your power price. Leave a picker empty to leave that role out. The next page sets up smart charging. Turn on 'Advanced setup' at the bottom to review every sensor by hand.

data.battery_capacity_kwh: Usable battery capacity in kWh (only used if model is 'Custom')
data.rated_wh_per_km: Rated consumption in Wh/km (only used if model is 'Custom')
data.advanced_setup: Advanced setup — show every sensor field so I can review or override them

data_description.vehicle_device_id: Your car from Tesla Custom, Tesla Fleet, Teslemetry or Tessie. Empty: pick the car's sensors by hand on the next page (any car).
data_description.zaptec_device_id: Your home charger, e.g. Zaptec — leave empty if you don't have one
data_description.monta_device_id: Your charging-control app/account, e.g. Monta — leave empty if you don't have one
data_description.spot_price_device_id: Your electricity-price integration, e.g. Nordpool or Strømligning — leave empty if you don't have one

fill_missing.title: Review sensors
fill_missing.description: Either something couldn't be found automatically, or you turned on advanced setup — either way, everything shown here is editable. Anything already found is pre-filled; just correct what needs it.

data.charging_binary_entity: Is charging (binary sensor, or a charging state sensor)
data.outside_temp_entity: Outside temperature sensor (optional, enables efficiency-vs-temperature tracking)

smart_charge.title: Smart charging
smart_charge.description: Charge when power is cheapest and let EV Ledger start and stop the charger. The car, the battery and the price sensor come from the ledger setup; fields left empty are found automatically (the Zaptec charger's mode sensor, the car's plug sensor).

data.notify_services: Phones to confirm the plan on

data_description.enabled: Adds charge plans (cheapest, fixed time, charge now, price cap, pause), a temporary trip plan and price per plan.
data_description.price_entities: Empty: the ledger's spot price sensor.
data_description.charger_type: Empty: Zaptec when the ledger uses a Zaptec charger.
data_description.car_plugged_entity: Empty: the car's own plug sensor. When it is off another car is at the charger and it is left alone.
data_description.notify_url: Dashboard path opened when the notification is tapped, e.g. /dashboard-ev/car.
data_description.notify_icon: Material Design Icon shown with the messages. Empty: mdi:ev-station.
data_description.car_climate_entity: Empty: the car's climate entity on the battery sensor's device. Needs a car integration that can send commands to the car (Tesla Fleet with the virtual key, Teslemetry or Tessie).
data_description.trip_calendar: Events in the next 36 hours become a temporary plan: the car has enough charge for the trip and leaves home in time for the event's start.
data_description.trip_calendar_keyword: Only events with this word in the title or description, e.g. 'car'. Empty: every event with an address.

error.no_prices: None of the sensors has a price list in its attributes.
error.required_for_zaptec: Pick the Zaptec charger mode sensor.

abort.already_configured: This car is already set up.

init.title: Reconfigure EV Ledger
init.description: One page for everything currently configured. Clear a Zaptec/Monta/price entity to drop that provider entirely.
